def semver_sort(versions):
    def parse_version(version):
        # Split by '+' to remove build metadata
        version_without_build = version.split('+')[0]
        
        # Split by '-' to separate core version and pre-release
        if '-' in version_without_build:
            core, prerelease = version_without_build.split('-', 1)
        else:
            core = version_without_build
            prerelease = None
        
        # Parse core version (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH)
        parts = core.split('.')
        major = int(parts[0])
        minor = int(parts[1]) if len(parts) > 1 else 0
        patch = int(parts[2]) if len(parts) > 2 else 0
        
        # Parse pre-release identifiers
        prerelease_identifiers = []
        if prerelease:
            identifiers = prerelease.split('.')
            for identifier in identifiers:
                if identifier.isdigit():
                    prerelease_identifiers.append((0, int(identifier)))
                else:
                    prerelease_identifiers.append((1, identifier))
        
        return (major, minor, patch, prerelease_identifiers)
    
    def compare_key(item):
        version_str, index = item
        major, minor, patch, prerelease = parse_version(version_str)
        # For sorting: (major, minor, patch, has_prerelease, prerelease_identifiers, original_index)
        # Note: no prerelease comes after prerelease, so we use "has_prerelease" to sort
        has_prerelease = 0 if prerelease else 1  # 0 means has prerelease (sorts first)
        return (major, minor, patch, has_prerelease, prerelease, index)
    
    # Create list of (version, original_index) to maintain stability
    indexed_versions = [(v, i) for i, v in enumerate(versions)]
    
    # Sort using the comparison key
    sorted_versions = sorted(indexed_versions, key=compare_key)
    
    # Return just the version strings
    return [v for v, _ in sorted_versions]
